account.description: This credits the commits you merge to you, and is what lets the platform open a PR as you when you accept. It is separate from the GitHub authorization used to sign in; it can be the same account, or a different one.
account.expired: Your GitHub authorization has expired: accepting a topic you take part in can no longer open a PR as you and falls back to merging straight into main. Click "Reconnect" to refresh it.
account.title: Connect a GitHub account

branchProtection.approvalsHint: A merge needs this many acceptances
branchProtection.approvalsInvalid: Approvals must be an integer of at least 1
branchProtection.autoMergeHint: When on, an acceptance stopped by a rule can auto-merge once every check passes
branchProtection.defaultReviewerHint: Used when a task is dispatched without a reviewer
branchProtection.dismissStaleHint: Code here is usually pushed by Cheese, so a new commit needs a fresh acceptance — on by default
branchProtection.enforcedByGithub: GitHub is enforcing the rules below
branchProtection.loadFailed: Couldn't load the branch protection rules
branchProtection.mergeMethodHint: A project linked to GitHub takes this from the repository settings; it can't be changed here
branchProtection.overrideHandlesHint: Who may let a merge through when checks fail; empty means the project owner and lead
branchProtection.requiredChecksHint: Every named check must pass before a merge; a check with a path scope is only required when the change touches those files
branchProtection.saveFailed: Couldn't save the branch protection rules
branchProtection.statusUnknown: GitHub's protection status can't be read right now; the rules below run as configured here
branchProtection.strict: Branch must be up to date with main before merging
branchProtection.strictHint: When on, the platform brings a stale branch up to date before merging
branchProtection.title: Branch protection

repo.description: Connect this project to a GitHub repository through cheesex-app; the short-lived credentials Cheese needs to read CI/CD are then issued from this connection automatically, with no manual setup.
repo.installPending: Installation requested, waiting for an organization admin to approve
repo.noInstallUrl: Connection failed: the backend returned no install link
repo.title: Connect a GitHub repository

settings.subtitle: Manage the runtime environment, repository connection and branch protection. To change roles or models, edit the teammate under "AI teammates".
settings.title: Project settings

upstream.description: Link an existing git repository and pull its history into this project; you can sync new commits at any time. When there are conflicts the sync stops as it is rather than merging only part of it.
upstream.placeholder: https://… or an absolute path on this machine (empty unlinks)
upstream.syncedCommits: Merged 1 upstream commit | Merged {count} upstream commits
upstream.title: Upstream repository
upstream.upToDate: Already up to date, no new commits
